add.description: Adds the argument to the value. Works with integers, floats, strings, and lists.

addslashes.description: Adds slashes before quotes. Useful for escaping strings in CSV.

capfirst.description: Capitalizes the first character of the value.

center.description: Centers the value in a field of a given width.

cut.description: Removes all occurrences of the argument from the string.

date.description: Formats a date. Common formats: Y-m-d, d/m/Y, D d M Y, N j Y, SHORT_DATE_FORMAT, DATE_FORMAT, d M Y H:i, jS F Y.

default.description: If value evaluates to False, uses the given default. Note: empty string is False.

default_if_none.description: If value is None, uses the given default. Unlike 'default', does not trigger on empty string.

dictsort.description: Sorts a list of dictionaries by the given key.

dictsortreversed.description: Sorts a list of dictionaries by the given key in reverse order.

divisibleby.description: Returns True if the value is divisible by the argument.

escape.description: Escapes HTML entities: <, >, ', ", &. Applied by default to template output.

escapejs.description: Escapes characters for use in JavaScript strings.

filesizeformat.description: Formats a file size as a human-readable string (e.g., '13 KB', '4.1 MB').

first.description: Returns the first item in a list.

floatformat.description: Rounds a float. Positive arg = always show decimals. Negative arg = only if needed. Default -1.

force_escape.description: Applies HTML escaping unconditionally. Use when chaining filters where autoescape would not apply.

get_digit.description: Returns the requested digit from right (1=ones, 2=tens, etc.).

iriencode.description: Converts an IRI to a string suitable for inclusion in a URL.

join.description: Joins a list with a string, like Python's str.join(list).

json_script.description: Outputs Python object as JSON in a <script> tag, safe for use in templates. Escapes <, > and &.

last.description: Returns the last item in a list.

length.description: Returns the length of the value (string or list).

length_is.description: Returns True if the value's length equals the argument.

linebreaks.description:
Converts newlines to HTML

and
tags.

linenumbers.description: Prepends line numbers to each line of text.

ljust.description: Left-aligns the value in a field of a given width.

lower.description: Converts the string to all lowercase.

make_list.description: Converts a value to a list. For a string, list of characters. For an integer, list of digits.

phone2numeric.description: Converts a phone number with letters to its numeric equivalent.

pluralize.description: Returns 's' if the value is not 1. Use pluralize:"es" or pluralize:"y,ies" for custom suffixes.

pluralize with suffix.description: Returns a plural suffix. Examples: pluralize:"es", pluralize:"y,ies".

pprint.description: Pretty-prints a value. Useful for debugging.

random.description: Returns a random item from the given list.

rjust.description: Right-aligns the value in a field of a given width.

safe.description: Marks a string as safe (not requiring HTML escaping). Use when you trust the content.

safeseq.description: Marks each item in a sequence as safe. Use with join after: {{ list|safeseq|join:", " }}.

slice.description: Returns a slice of the list. Uses Python slice syntax: :N, N:, N:M, ::step.

slugify.description: Converts to ASCII lowercase, removes non-alphanumeric chars, converts spaces to hyphens.

stringformat.description: Formats the value according to Python string formatting spec (without leading %). E.g. 'd', '.2f', 's'.

striptags.description: Strips all HTML tags. Not guaranteed safe for untrusted input; use bleach for sanitization.

time.description: Formats a time. Common formats: H:i, H:i:s, g:i A, P (12-hour with am/pm), TIME_FORMAT.

timesince.description: Formats a date as the time since that date (e.g., '4 days, 6 hours').

timesince with reference.description: Formats time since a date relative to a reference date instead of now.

timeuntil.description: Formats a date as the time until that date (e.g., '4 days, 6 hours').

timeuntil with reference.description: Formats time until a date relative to a reference date instead of now.

title.description: Converts a string to titlecase (first letter of each word capitalized).

truncatechars.description: Truncates a string to the given number of characters, appending '...' if truncated.

truncatechars_html.description: Like truncatechars but aware of HTML tags. Tags that were opened are properly closed.

truncatewords.description: Truncates a string after the given number of words, appending '...' if truncated.

truncatewords_html.description: Like truncatewords but aware of HTML tags. Tags that were opened are properly closed.

unordered_list.description: Recursively renders a nested list as HTML <li> items. Does NOT include the outer <ul> tag.

upper.description: Converts the string to all uppercase.

urlencode.description: Escapes a value for use in a URL. By default encodes '/' too; use urlencode:"" to leave '/' alone.

urlize.description: Converts URLs and email addresses in text into clickable links.

urlizetrunc.description: Like urlize but truncates the displayed link text to the given character limit.

wordcount.description: Returns the number of words in the value.

wordwrap.description: Wraps words at the specified line length.

yesno.description: Maps True, False, and optionally None to custom strings. Default: 'yes,no,maybe'.
